en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard. One side shows a rural landscape with hills and trees in the background, and in the foreground a traditional well with a long wooden sweep (draw‑well) beside low stone walls; Hungarian postage stamps are affixed in the lower right corner. The other side contains handwritten correspondence in Hungarian, an address written in French to a recipient in Paris, and a blue airmail label reading "LÉGI POSTA PAR AVION." The correspondence side is dated 1931 and mentions Pécs, Hungary.
